prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Dallas for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—your bite, treatment goals, budget, and preferred location all matter. A good starting point is **Dr. Vikas Gupta**, whose American Association of Orthodontists profile lists him as **board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics** and trained in orthodontics at the University of the Pacific. His office is in **Oak Cliff**. [AAO profile](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/dr-vikas-gupta/)

Other options to compare include **Dr. Hessam Rahimi** in North Dallas, also listed as board-certified by the AAO, and **Walnut Central Orthodontics**, which offers both braces and Invisalign. [Dr. Rahimi’s AAO profile](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/dr-hessam-rahimi-2/) · [Walnut Central Orthodontics](https://nationalorthodonticregistry.com/texas/dallas-tx/orthodontists/walnut-central-orthodontics-dallas-tx)

I’d book two or three consultations and compare the proposed treatment plan, total cost, who handles your visits, and how they manage follow-up or emergencies. If you share your part of Dallas and whether this is for an adult or child, I can narrow the options down.
